entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Finally! I need to return these useless cycling shoes I bought from you. My order number is VF88-291-B. Look it up and process my refund.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order... VF88-291-B. I see the order for the cycling shoes here. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?

What's the issue? The issue is they're garbage! I've been riding for years, and I've never had shoes give me blisters this bad. On top of that, the cleats won't mount properly. I've had it. I want my money back. This is unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear about the trouble with the fit and the blisters, that sounds incredibly uncomfortable. I understand your frustration completely.

You'd better understand! I'm not paying for defective gear. If I don't get a full refund authorization on this call, I'm lighting you up on every cycling forum and social media platform I can find. Get me your manager right now.
I understand you'd like to speak with a manager, but I am empowered to handle this return for you. Let me just review the policy for your item. One moment please.
Don't put me on hold. Just do it. I've had these things for 45 days. It took me a few weeks of trying to break them in to realize they were junk.

No problem, I'm checking it right now... Okay, I see here you received the order 45 days ago. According to our return policy, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day window for a return. I can absolutely process that for you.
Wait, really? You're just going to give me the refund? No hassle?

That's correct. I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just package the shoes, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Huh. Okay. Well, that's what I wanted in the first place. I just got the email with the label. Thank you.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
